proposals.before: The Gannan general Jueluo Shushu led imperial guards south into Guangdong and was defeated by Shang Zhixin's general Yan Ziming; the army retreated to within thirty li of Ganzhou.
proposals.after: The Zhennan General Jueluo Shushu led imperial guards south into Guangdong and was defeated by Shang Zhixin's general Yan Ziming; the army retreated to within thirty li of Ganzhou.
proposals.reason: 鎮南將軍 is Zhennan General (General Who Pacifies the South), not Gannan; literal conflates 鎮南 with 贛南.

proposals.before: When the special erudition examination opened, Wei Xiangju nominated Zishou and Tang Bin to compete.
proposals.after: When the special erudition examination opened, Wei Xiangshu nominated Zishou and Tang Bin to compete.
proposals.reason: 魏象樞 is Wei Xiangshu (樞 shū); Xiangju misreads the given name.

proposals.before: When the Boxue Hongci examination was opened, Wei Xiangju recommended Zishou together with Tang Bin to sit for it.
proposals.after: When the Boxue Hongci examination was opened, Wei Xiangshu recommended Zishou together with Tang Bin to sit for it.
proposals.reason: 魏象樞 is Wei Xiangshu (樞 shū); Xiangju misreads the given name.

proposals.before: A man had a stepmother who was wanton and wished also to violate his daughter by the first wife; she refused and was killed.
proposals.after: A commoner had a second wife who was wanton and wished also to violate his daughter by the first wife; she refused and was killed.
proposals.reason: 繼妻 is the man's subsequent wife (stepmother to the daughter), not the man's stepmother; literal reverses the kinship.

proposals.before: The emperor sent Minister Zhang Tinglu to investigate; following Mengqiu, conspirators were executed and duped commoners released.
proposals.after: The emperor sent Minister Zhang Tingshu to investigate; following Mengqiu, conspirators were executed and duped commoners released.
proposals.reason: 張廷樞 is Zhang Tingshu (樞 shū); Tinglu misreads the given name.

proposals.before: The emperor ordered Minister Zhang Tinglu to investigate; following Mengqiu's proposal those who joined the rebellion were executed and deluded commoners who were enticed were all released.
proposals.after: The emperor ordered Minister Zhang Tingshu to investigate; following Mengqiu's proposal those who joined the rebellion were executed and deluded commoners who were enticed were all released.
proposals.reason: 張廷樞 is Zhang Tingshu (樞 shū); Tinglu misreads the given name.

decisions.reason: s0017 opens with 鎮南將軍覺羅舒恕; 鎮南 is Zhennan (the title), not 贛南 Gannan. The prior literal conflates the title with the Ganzhou region; Zhennan General restores the correct reading.
s0034 names 魏象樞; 樞 is shū, so Wei Xiangshu, not Xiangju. The proposed idiomatic correction fixes a clear given-name misreading without changing sense.
The same Chinese 魏象樞 requires Wei Xiangshu in the literal field. Xiangju misreads 樞; the proposed replacement is accurate.

s0155 has 民有繼妻素淫，欲並亂前妻女; 繼妻 is the commoner's subsequent wife (stepmother to the first wife's daughter), not the man's stepmother. The prior literal reverses kinship; the proposed second wife restores it.

decisions.reason: s0214 names 尚書張廷樞; 樞 is shū, so Zhang Tingshu, not Tinglu. The proposed idiomatic correction fixes the given-name misreading.
Literal likewise misreads 張廷樞 as Tinglu; Tingshu matches 樞 and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
